title: Chilly Day Chili
description: A chilly day will be more cozy with a pot of this light and easy chili simmering on the stove. You can also cook it in the slow cooker for 8 hours on Low or 3 hours on High.
ingredients: 3 (15 ounce) cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes with juice
1 (14.5 ounce) can Mexican-style stewed tomatoes with chiles, undrained

steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a soup pot over medium heat. Cook and stir ground chicken in the hot oil until no longer pink and the chicken is crumbly, about 10 minutes. Drain.

Stir in pinto beans, onions, diced tomatoes, Mexican-style stewed tomatoes, water, brown sugar, chili powder, vinegar, mustard, salt, and black pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer chili until thickened and flavors have blended, about 3 hours. Stir occasionally and add extra water if needed.
